name: Food Receiving & Delivery Temperature Log
secondary_keywords: chilled goods receiving temperature limit uk
search_intent: Goods-in clerks, head chefs, and kitchen intake staff seeking an authoritative delivery temperature log to inspect vehicle cleanliness, verify chilled goods under 5°C (8°C statutory max), probe frozen goods (≤-18°C), and document batch traceability codes.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Paper-based SFBB diary sheets that must be printed and filed manually.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Informative training article with static printable PDF checklist.

competitors.name: SafetyCulture
competitors.features: Mobile intake app requiring user signup and monthly subscription.

competitors.name: WebstaurantStore
competitors.features: US-centric guide using Fahrenheit and FDA guidelines.

competitors.name: Daydots / Ecolab
competitors.features: Commercial supplier catalog for physical paper logs and temperature labels.

gap_analysis.competitor_weaknesses: Vulnerable paper sheets that get torn and grease-stained on loading docks; foreign templates that cite 41°F rather than UK 8°C statutory limits and 5°C best practice.
our_differentiators: Interactive intake inspection checklist + live digital temperature probe logger
UK statutory rejection thresholds: chilled >8°C, frozen >-15°C, broken seals
Supplier traceability fields (PO/invoice number, batch code, expiry date)
Immediate A4 delivery record printout and CSV export
